modelAliasHint: The model alias its runs use, as the project's AI settings name them.
tools.title: Tools
tools.hint: What this agent may do with each tool. A tool that only reads runs; one that changes things asks unless it's set to run; a change in another system asks every time. Skills and such changes are off until turned on. A run that has read outside content or beyond its project asks before every change.
title: Agents
subtitle: AI teammates with accounts of their own. Each works with the rights of whoever starts it, under its own name. A project takes the site's agents on, or makes its own.
switchOff: Agents are off: none can be made, and none works.
switchHint: Turning them on asks you to confirm it's you.
operatorOff: The operator hasn't allowed agents on this site. Whoever runs the servers sets Agents:AdminsMayEnable.
safeMode: The site started in safe mode: every agent is held until it starts without it.
name: Name
keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Its account is named after it, and it can't change.
instructionsHint: In Markdown: what it does, how, and what it must never do.
roleHint: For the runs the system starts here. Runs a person starts use that person's rights.
projectSubtitle: This project's own agents, and the site's offered to it. A project takes an agent on with a role for the runs the system starts here.
runs.expires: Refused if no one answers by {at}.
runs.title: Agents
runs.hint: What agents did on this item: who asked, how it went, and each step.
runs.steps: {count, plural, =0 {No tool steps} one {# tool step} other {# tool steps}}
runs.outcomes.unknown: unknown: it stopped while this ran
limits.title: Limits
limits.hint: What this agent may spend and do. Its own AI limits count every call its runs make, inside the site's and the projects' limits. A run stops at whichever limit it reaches first; an empty field is the site's.
limits.spent: {runs, plural, =0 {No runs} one {# run} other {# runs}}, {failed} failed, {cost} spent
memory.title: Memory
memory.hint: What this agent learned about items in its runs, for its next runs: a run on one is given its newest notes, and recall finds more near it. A note reaches only runs whose person may read what it's about. One kept after outside content marks the runs it reaches, so their changes ask first.
chat.title: Agents
chat.private: Only you see your chats. A reply stays here until you post it.
chat.noneHint: Ask an agent about an item from its page, or start a chat here.
chat.noPlaces: No agent works in a project you can read yet.
chat.first: What do you want to ask?
chat.keys: Enter sends; Shift+Enter starts a new line.
chat.busy: Wait for the reply, or stop it, before you write again.
chat.working: {agent} is working{count, plural, =0 {} one { · # tool so far} other { · # tools so far}}
chat.postedNote: {agent}'s reply is now a comment on {key}.
chat.deleteBody: Its messages and replies go for good. What the agent changed stays, and so does the record of what it ran.
select.none: No agent is taken on here yet: take one on in the Agents settings.
graph.off: The graph is off on this site: {why}
graph.waiting: {count, plural, one {# note isn't in the graph yet} other {# notes aren't in the graph yet}}: notes are read in after their runs.
graph.empty: Nothing in the graph yet. Notes are read into it after their runs.
graph.noMatch: No thing or fact has those words.
graph.pick: Pick a thing to see what the agent knows about it.
graph.picture: {name} and {count, plural, one {the thing its facts reach} other {the # things its facts reach}}
graph.hidden: {count, plural, one {# more fact comes} other {# more facts come}} from notes you can't read.
permissions.title: Agents you always allow
permissions.hint: Tools you let an agent use without asking, in the runs you start, one project each. Take one back and the agent asks you again.
permissions.agentHint: Tools people let this agent use without asking, in the runs they start. Taking one back makes it ask them again.
permissions.takeBackTitle: Take back {agent}'s use of {tool} without asking?
mine.title: Questions for you
mine.hint: What agents’ runs wait for you to answer.
